content_zh:
墨镜男犹豫道：“这玩意很昂贵，我们手上的存货不多了。”
女子坚持道：“放一个，他值这个价。”
“好吧，如你所愿，殿下。”
墨镜男摇摇头，小心翼翼的摸出一个通体银色的小盒子，轻轻放在大厦顶部的一处隐秘所在。
那小盒子一放下来，立刻就隐去了形状。
墨镜男耸耸肩，摸出微型光脑道：“来吧，让我看看长宁钢铁战甲科技公司的员工资料。”
光脑上无数条个人信息往上滑去，墨镜男忽然在一个头像上点了一下。
这是一张年轻帅气的面孔，透着青春期特有的活力。
“没错，就是他。”
墨镜男双手在键盘上飞速点击，终于，一个进度条出现在屏幕上。
微型光脑开始读取顾青山个人资料。
墨镜男抬手看了看手表，吐槽道：“15秒才能追踪到我，真是垃圾的防护系统，长宁苏家太不关爱员工了。”
仅仅过了7秒钟，墨镜男已经得到了资料，果断的关闭了入侵系统。
他在顾青山个人资料上连续点击，很快调出了对方的生物波段和生命特征。
“顾青山，你跑不掉了。”
墨镜男微微一笑，将对方的信息录入到监视机器人中。
傍晚，顾青山结束了一天的研究，吃过晚饭，在公司的人工主球场上散了散步。
抬头朝天际望去，低垂的夜幕下，明月高挂，一颗颗星辰如钻石般闪亮。
清风送爽，好一个惬意的夜晚。
顾青山默默的眯起眼，丹田灵力一动，瞬间覆盖住眼目。

眼前景象忽然一变，天空上漂浮着丝丝缕缕的暗灰色烟雾，如绸缎一般悄无声息的席卷而来。
顾青山皱了皱眉。
暗灰色的气息，是黄泉之气，末日的端倪已经出现。
“还有不到一年的时间。”顾青山喃喃道。
他加快脚步，回到了公司安排的个人房间。
从昨天夜间回归算起，也差不多到了一天时间，该进入异世界了。
顾青山调出游戏界面，看了看沙漏上的时间。
正好，最后一粒沙落了下去。
一道光幕闪过，顾青山整个人消失在房间中。
清晨时分。
顾青山站在屋檐下，似乎只离开了一刹那，就再次来到了异世界。
营地外，妖兽的尸体依旧躺在营地外，插满箭矢的创口汩汩冒出鲜血。
顾青山发现自己依然举着弓，单膝跪地，面朝着军营门口做出射击的姿势。
一切都像是他根本没离开过一样。
顾青山站起来，喊了一声：“赵六！”
没有动静，也没有人回应。
顾青山无奈的吼道：“赵六，结束了，出来！”
等了好一会儿，赵六才哆哆嗦嗦的来到顾青山身后。
他从顾青山肩膀上探出头，朝外望了一眼。
“死、死了？”

“死了，来，跟我一起去抬进来。”
赵六看看那头妖兽，再看看顾青山，咂舌道：“顾兄弟，想不到你这么厉害。”
顾青山道：“少废话，去取工具来，我们把妖兽弄回军营。”
赵六壮着胆子，又看了一眼妖兽，欢喜道：“娘咧，这么大一头，足够我们吃上一个月了。”
顾青山点点头，心中也是安定了些。
妖兽肉蕴含充沛的气血之力，就是普通人吃了，也能强筋健骨，壮益气血。
他凭着两枚疗伤丹治愈了体内伤势，结果一回到现实世界，连续战斗了两场，第二场对付的还是武道宗师，简直耗尽了所有的心神和体力。
这一刻，顾青山能察觉到身周都有隐隐的疼痛。
正是刚愈合的伤口，再次出现了轻微迸裂。
这种情况下，若是能一直吃上妖兽肉，再休养一阵，对身体会大有裨益。
赵六一溜烟跑进伙房，拿了大的网兜、长绳、剔骨刀等一应工具。
两人做好准备，往军营外走去。
顾青山边走边问：“营地前的死人坑，为什么不掩埋？毕竟都是同袍。”
赵六发起牢骚：“之前伍长根本不管，我一个伙夫有什么办法？我若独自离开军营去挖坑，万一遇上什么怪物，岂不是必死无疑。”
顾青山拍拍他肩膀，道：“等把妖兽弄进来，你跟我去把死人坑埋了。”
赵六犹豫着没说话。
顾青山又道：“死人坑的血腥气太浓，要是引来强大妖魔，窥破军营的隐匿法阵，你我都只有死路一条。”
“这，好吧！”
赵六想着那情景，终于咬牙应了一声。
两人走到军营门口，赵六抬腿刚要迈出营地，却被顾青山扯着领子拽回来，差点在地上摔了个仰八叉。

content_en:
The man in sunglasses hesitated: "This thing is very expensive, and we don't have much stock on hand."
The woman insisted: "Put one away, he is worth the price."
"Well, as you wish, Your Highness."
The man in sunglasses shook his head, carefully took out a small silver box, and placed it gently in a secret place on the top of the building.
As soon as the small box was put down, its shape immediately disappeared.
The man in sunglasses shrugged, took out the micro-optical brain and said, "Come on, let me see the employee information of Changning Steel Armor Technology Company."
Countless personal information slid up on the optical brain, and the man in sunglasses suddenly clicked on a profile picture.
This is a young and handsome face, exuding the unique vitality of adolescence.
"Yes, that's him."
The man in sunglasses clicked quickly on the keyboard with both hands, and finally, a progress bar appeared on the screen.
The micro optical computer began to read Gu Qingshan's personal information.
The man in sunglasses raised his hand to look at his watch and complained: "It takes 15 seconds to track me. It's such a rubbish protection system. The Changning Su family doesn't care about its employees."
After only 7 seconds, the man in sunglasses had obtained the information and decisively shut down the intrusion system.
He clicked continuously on Gu Qingshan's profile and quickly called up the other person's biological band and life characteristics.
"Gu Qingshan, you can't run away."
The man in sunglasses smiled slightly and entered the other party's information into the surveillance robot.
In the evening, Gu Qingshan finished his day's research, had dinner, and took a walk on the company's artificial main court.
Looking up at the sky, under the low night sky, the bright moon hangs high, and the stars shine like diamonds.
The breeze was refreshing, and it was a pleasant night.
Gu Qingshan narrowed his eyes silently, and the spiritual energy in his dantian moved, covering his eyes instantly.
The scene in front of him suddenly changed. Threads of dark gray smoke floated in the sky, sweeping in silently like silk.
Gu Qingshan frowned.
The dark gray aura is the aura of underworld, and the signs of the end have already appeared.
"There is less than a year left." Gu Qingshan murmured.
He quickened his pace and returned to the personal room arranged by the company.
Counting from the return last night, it was almost a day and it was time to enter another world.
Gu Qingshan brought up the game interface and looked at the time on the hourglass.
Just in time, the last grain of sand fell.
A curtain of light flashed and Gu Qingshan disappeared into the room.
Early morning hours.
Gu Qingshan stood under the eaves, as if he had only left for a moment before entering another world again.
Outside the camp, the corpse of the monster was still lying outside the camp, with blood gushing out from the wounds filled with arrows.
Gu Qingshan found that he was still holding the bow, kneeling on one knee, facing the entrance of the military camp, making a shooting posture.
It was as if he had never left at all.
Gu Qingshan stood up and shouted: "Zhao Liu!"
There was no movement and no one responded.
Gu Qingshan shouted helplessly: "Zhao Liu, it's over, come out!"
After waiting for a while, Zhao Liu came tremblingly behind Gu Qingshan.
He poked his head out from Gu Qingshan's shoulder and took a look outside.
"Dead, dead?"
"He's dead. Come, come with me and carry him in."
Zhao Liu looked at the monster, then at Gu Qingshan, smacking his tongue and saying, "Brother Gu, I didn't expect you to be so powerful."
Gu Qingshan said: "Stop talking nonsense, go get the tools, and let's get the monster back to the military camp."
Zhao Liu plucked up the courage, took another look at the monster, and said happily: "Mom, such a big one is enough for us to eat for a month."
Gu Qingshan nodded, feeling more settled.
Monster meat contains abundant energy and blood. Even if ordinary people eat it, it can strengthen their muscles and bones and strengthen their energy and blood.
He healed the injuries in his body with two healing pills. As soon as he returned to the real world, he fought two battles in a row. The second battle was against a martial arts master, which exhausted all his energy and energy.
thisFor a moment, Gu Qingshan could feel the faint pain all over his body.
It was the newly healed wound that cracked slightly again.
In this case, if you can keep eating monster meat and rest for a while, it will be of great benefit to your body.
Zhao Liuyi ran into the kitchen and took a large net bag, a long rope, a boning knife and other tools.
The two of them got ready and walked outside the military camp.
Gu Qingshan asked as he walked: "Why don't you bury the dead people in the pit in front of the camp? After all, they are all colleagues."
Zhao Liu complained: "The corps commander didn't care before. What can I do as a cook? If I leave the barracks alone to dig a hole, if I encounter some monster, I will definitely die."
Gu Qingshan patted him on the shoulder and said: "When the monster is brought in, you and I will bury the dead in the pit."
Zhao Liu hesitated and said nothing.
Gu Qingshan added: "The bloody smell of the death pit is too strong. If it attracts powerful demons and peeks through the hidden magic circle of the military camp, both you and I will die."
"This, okay!"
Zhao Liu thought about that scene and finally gritted his teeth and responded.
The two of them walked to the entrance of the military camp. Zhao Liu raised his legs and was about to step out of the camp when Gu Qingshan pulled him back by his collar and almost fell to the ground.
